fixes.summary: Applied every finding from reviews['plugin:core-A'] and reviews['plugin:importer'] plus items A–M. Core: (A) ListTables sorts events/records by a named EXISTS meta clause OR-ed with NOT EXISTS (WP builds LEFT JOINs) so undated/zero-meta events stay listed, filters merged under an AND wrapper; (B) Privacy: is_embed()+is_singular(hk9_barkode) -> 404 at template_redirect prio 0, oembed_response_data -> false (prio 100, after core's enrichers which would coerce an early false back to an array; scrub_oembed_author now tolerates false); (C) Registrar removes the postcustom box for hk9_* types and marks hk9_* meta protected via is_protected_meta (custom-fields support kept; registered auth callbacks still allow REST edits — sections-test 33/33 still passes); (K) color inputs get label_for, image buttons get aria-labels, redirect row-action keys rawurlencoded (ListTable + Admin::url), Dates::query bounds the no-end branch by start and pre-computes sort timestamps, sanitize_link drops bare '#' and upgrades '//' to https:, tax_statement default is the live sentence verbatim (typo corrected per conflict-log S6). Importer: (D) allowlist = get_allowed_mime_types() minus SVG/HEIC/HEIF/script/executable types (mp4, docx, pdf pass; real payload validates with only the unreferenced ref:asset:favicon SVG rejected); (E) templates written via wp_update_post page_template with a whitelist covering current+new values (meta_input no longer silently reverted); (F) PostFields::preflight_content() in posts_hierarchy fails a record (stub stays draft + pending) when any content/deferred-meta token cannot resolve or block counts change, plus a posts_content safety net that reverts a first-import publish with empty content to draft and re-records the status hash; (G) Options step reconciles per dot-path leaf (Options::leaves/path_get/path_set/path_unset; Rollback restores per path); (M) unresolvable leaf tokens warn + drop instead of failing the settings record; (H) Validate enforces key == redirect:<from> (normalised), build-payload.mjs now fails on it too; (I) wp_slash for wp_insert_term, nav-menu item args (import + rollback) and _wp_attachment_image_alt; (J) duplicate WP-CLI registration removed from Import\Rest, docblock corrected; low items: Payload::resolve_within walks to the nearest existing ancestor (missing file != escape) and rejects '..' segments, import.js strings routed through cfg.i18n with th scope=col, upload notice via per-user transient, Runner::status() computed once per request, common user-facing importer messages wrapped in __(). build-payload.mjs additionally leaves unreferenced SVG/HEIC media-index entries out of the manifest (fails the build if referenced). (L) verified hk9_quote/hk9_veteran_name/hk9_branch/hk9_canine_name are registered. Added tests/importer-suite.sh (58 checks, all pass) and tests/core-fixes-test.php (32 checks, all pass); real-payload dry run: 364 records, 250 media create/adopt, 79 posts, 31 menu items, 170 settings leaves, 22 redirects, 1 expected record error (favicon SVG).

t2.summary: Built the T2 stream: 11 migrated page templates (landing, donate, events, campaigns, partners, people, teams, highlighted-team, gallery, application, thank-you), 13 section parts (tiers, options, mail_in, tax, upcoming, past, logos, grid, team, gallery_options, application_form, campaigns_list, teams_list), 6 shared record cards (event, campaign, team, person, partner, story), 5 CPT singles (story, team, event, campaign, barkode) and the helper module inc/template-tags-records.php (all helpers use a distinct hk9_rec_ prefix after a parallel-stream collision), plus SCSS in _pages-migrated.scss / _singles.scss only. Everything follows the foundation system (navy hero band + overlap card + section rhythm, hk9-card/hk9-btn/hk9-status/hk9-callout). Key mechanics: hk9_rec_render_sections() renders sections with per-template part remaps (campaigns/teams `list` -> campaigns_list/teams_list, application `form` -> application_form, since the plugin registers those under shared types `list`/`form`) and before/after injection callbacks for the block-content card (landing/thank-you after hero, application before form); galleries (page gallery block, gallery_options.images, story/team/campaign galleries, BarKode ID cards) run through the core gallery block with the core Interactivity-API lightbox forced on via a render_block_data filter (links unwrapped, captions stripped when off, columns overridden) - verified opening/closing in Chromium at 1440 and 390 with prev/next navigation; events use hk9_events_query()/hk9_event_datetime_range() with plugin-less fallbacks, month/day date block, cancelled/postponed badges, external registration links forced to a new tab; event single has a plain Google Maps 'Get directions' link (no embed); BarKode single renders the .hk9-record layout and never reads review notes (grep-verified, robots noindex + generic description confirmed). Temporary content (7 attachments, 32 records/pages, all tmp- prefixed) was created via WP-CLI, screenshotted at 1440/390 (42 PNGs in scratchpad/wave2/t2), checked (one h1, 0 console errors, 0 external requests, 0 empty hrefs, no horizontal scroll, axe clean except a heading-order note caused by test/live content using h3 after h1), and deleted afterwards. Real pages did not exist yet when I finished (only fixture attachments and another stream's tmp-news page remain).

Plugin section types collide across templates: hk9_section_definitions() reports type 'list' for both stories (T1 part list.php) and campaigns/teams, and type 'form' for both contact (T1 form.php) and application. The foundation renderer hk9_render_sections() would therefore load the wrong part, so my templates call hk9_rec_render_sections(), which remaps by template (see hk9_rec_section_type_map()). Recommend the plugin owner set explicit 'type' => 'campaigns_list' / 'teams_list' / 'application_form' in Sections/definitions/{campaigns,teams,application}.php so the generic renderer (and front-page.php's page-sections fallback) resolve correctly too.

The application page layout stores the pseudo-section id 'intro'; the plugin's hk9_sections_layout() drops it, so application.php injects the content card before the 'form' section (hidden-section safe: injections whose anchor never renders still run at the end).
Content-level heading order: the thank-you/landing block content (e.g. live__page__2505.html) starts with an h3 directly under the page h1; axe flags heading-order. Content owner may want h2 there.

Shared-environment collision (not mine): theme/inc/template-tags-pages.php and theme/inc/template-tags-records.php both declared hk9_record_meta(), which made every front-end request a PHP fatal for ~5 minutes mid-session; it was resolved by those streams. Other agents also flipped show_on_front/page_for_posts/page_on_front/posts_per_page and rewrote hk9_settings while I tested (one intermediate run captured posts_per_page=6), and a foreign process retitled fixture post 421 to 'Edited About'; final runs were re-done with settings re-asserted and are consistent.
axe serious color-contrast on .hk9-footer__tagline (crimson italic on navy) on every page — foundation footer.php/_footer.scss, outside T3.

Foundation _forms.scss was rewritten by another stream during the session (form __row became __grid and .hk9-form__field now spans the full grid row); the comment form therefore defines its own .hk9-comments .comment-form .hk9-form__row grid in _blog-states.scss so it does not depend on that contract.

Fixture embed markup originally put the YouTube URL on the same line as the wrapper div, so WP_Embed::autoembed never resolved it; fixed (URL on its own line like the editor emits) — the first verification pass therefore showed no external requests on the rich post, the final pass shows the YouTube iframe requests (documented exception).
Plugin (not mine) logs 'rest_validate_value_from_schema was called incorrectly: the type schema keyword for caption…' on front-end requests (debug.log).

Core behaviours kept as-is and documented: sticky posts reappear in natural order on later pages; a 3-column gallery lets the orphan 4th image fill its row; core prefixes protected titles with 'Protected:'.
t3.integration_notes:
TEMPLATE HIERARCHY: category.php/tag.php/author.php/date.php are deliberately NOT provided — archive.php handles all four (plus is_tax/is_post_type_archive) through hk9_archive_context() which returns {eyebrow,title,title_html,text,image,type} (filter hk9/theme/archive_context). The 'get_the_archive_title_prefix' filter is set to '' theme-wide. index.php is the generic fallback and renders the same listing. home.php title/text/image order: blog.hero_title -> posts-page title -> 'News'; blog.hero_text -> posts-page excerpt; blog.hero_image -> posts-page thumbnail. The posts page must be assigned via Reading settings (the importer's 'reading' record); /news/page/N/ pagination works through core + the plugin's listing rewrite rule.

HELPERS (inc/template-tags-blog.php, all theme-only, plugin-independent): hk9_blog_option(key), hk9_blog_layout(), hk9_blog_url(), hk9_archive_context(), hk9_blog_empty_copy(), hk9_blog_helpful_links() (filter hk9/theme/helpful_links; About resolves get_page_by_path('about'), Program/Contact/Donate from links.provider/links.contact/links.donate, News from page_for_posts), hk9_blog_listing([layout, highlight]), hk9_blog_post_card($post, [layout list|grid|compact, highlight, heading h2|h3]), hk9_blog_post_meta($post, [light, comments, class]), hk9_blog_post_terms($post, taxonomy, [class,label,limit]) -> <ul class="hk9-blog__terms">, hk9_blog_related_posts($post, $count) (same categories, newest first, fallback latest; filter hk9/theme/related_posts), hk9_search_highlight($escaped, $query) (only on esc_html output), hk9_blog_initials(), hk9_blog_avatar($name, $size, $class) (initials, filter hk9/theme/avatar to swap in get_avatar()), hk9_blog_post_pages() (wp_link_pages), hk9_blog_card_excerpt(), hk9_comment_callback(), hk9_comment_form_defaults()/hk9_comment_form_fields() (comment_form_defaults / comment_form_default_fields filters), hk9_password_form() (the_password_form filter -> template-parts/content/page-password.php, works for pages too since page.php calls the_content), comment-reply enqueue on singular+open+threaded, body classes hk9-blog/hk9-blog--{list|grid}/hk9-single-post. Other streams may reuse hk9_blog_post_card() for post lists and hk9_blog_avatar() for people cards; hk9_post_card() from the foundation is untouched.

CSS (assets/src/scss/_blog-states.scss only): .hk9-hero--blog(+ --has-image), .hk9-hero--post(--post-has-image), .hk9-blog__overlap/__inner(--grid), card additions (.hk9-blog__card-media--placeholder, __card-top, __card-badge, __card-footer, --sticky, --compact, --protected), .hk9-blog__meta-item/-sep/--light, .hk9-blog__terms--light/--tags, .hk9-post__{overlap,featured,body,content,after,tags,footer,comments}, .hk9-post-pages, .hk9-avatar (--hk9-avatar-size), .hk9-author-box, .hk9-blog__nav-label/-title, .hk9-blog__related-header, .hk9-blog__empty-*, .hk9-search__{label,input,submit,submit-label}, .hk9-404__{search,links,title}, .hk9-comments__{list,respond,reply-title,cancel,closed} + .hk9-comment__*, .comment-navigation, .hk9-password-form__*, .hk9-attachment__*, mark.hk9-mark, and embed fixes scoped to .hk9-post__content (aspect-ratio only when the wrapper :has(iframe); unresolved embeds become a muted URL box). Note for the foundation: _navigation_markup() runs sanitize_html_class() so only ONE class can be passed to the_posts_pagination()/the_comments_navigation(); the foundation's .hk9-blog__nav span rule styles every span as an uppercase label, so nav titles carry !important overrides.

PRIVACY/DESIGN DECISIONS: author names are plain text (no /author/<login>/ links) because the plugin hardens user enumeration; author archives still render when requested. Avatars never call Gravatar. Comments closed with 0 comments render nothing; closed with existing comments show the list + 'Comments are closed.' Protected posts hide featured image, excerpt, tags, related and comments until unlocked and show a wrong-password alert based on the postpass cookie. Attachment pages render only when wp_attachment_pages_enabled=1 (WP 6.4+ default is off).

FIXTURES (docker/fixtures/blog-fixtures.php): now also creates an empty tag ('fixture-empty-tag'), makes the oldest post sticky, adds a pullquote and an alignfull image to the rich post, uses palette slug 'muted', and puts the embed URL on its own line so autoembed resolves it (needs outbound network; the docker stack has it). Environment restored: fixtures deleted, tmp-news (422) deleted, show_on_front=posts, page_on_front=0, page_for_posts=0, wp_attachment_pages_enabled=0, page_comments=0, comments_per_page=50, hk9_settings.blog removed. Screenshots/report: scratchpad/wave2/t3/ (report.json, axe.md, *-390.png, *-1440.png, embed/gallery viewport captures).
